representation_fit.evidence: Primary representation is a physical floor-plan canvas: four purpose zones (展示区/体验区/调试角/暂存区) with 13 canvas_object item cards placed inside and 2 staged outside (source/app.js:20-25, 39-53; world 1120x660 app.js:15). Matches the brief's spatial-workspace/physical bundle and canvas_object suggestion; both screenshots (1280x860, 1440x900) show the zone-tagged board as the dominant surface.

primary_task_salience.evidence: Create-and-place dominates: canvas fills ~90% of both viewports; ＋新建 is the first toolbar button (source/index.html:20, screenshot 1280x860 top bar); double-click creates in place (source/app.js:392-398); the core rule is printed in the status bar '落位即意图：物件落入分区 ⇒ 用途自动确定' (app.js:206, visible bottom bar both viewports); two 未安置 items (纸箱×若干, 折叠椅) visually stage the pending placement task.

time_to_understand.evidence: Model-judged proxy: brand subtitle '工作坊开放日 · 平面布置板' states the job (source/index.html:16); zone tags carry purpose+live count (app.js:144); every card shows a location-derived purpose chip or 未安置 (app.js:150-154, visible in both screenshots); status bar states the rule plus key hints. What/where/how is conveyed in a single glance.

navigation_cost.evidence: Single main screen, no modes, no pan/zoom — the canvas auto-fits the viewport ('画布总是完整可见，无平移导航' source/app.js:676-686); the primary object is reachable in one action: N key (app.js:519-524), toolbar button (index.html:20), or double-click (app.js:392-398); Tab cycles selection (app.js:503-507). Zero structural navigation steps.

context_loss.evidence: All primary actions are in-place: rename is an inline input inside the card (app.js:164-179, 463-477), moves keep zones and status visible, full undo/redo with coalesced nudges (app.js:101-130), help overlay is Esc-dismissable without clearing selection (app.js:509-513). No navigation away from the canvas exists in source or UI structure.

ui_surface_complexity.evidence: Three permanent surfaces only — quiet toolbar, dominant canvas, status bar (source/index.html:11-49); no forms, sidebars, or at-rest modals; the keymap is a task-driven hidden overlay (index.html:52, styles.css:312+). Each of the 7 toolbar controls duplicates a keyboard action, so permanent chrome stays minimal relative to need.

accessibility.evidence: Receipt: a11y.target_size pass, a11y.contrast fail, a11y.focus_order skipped (measurement-summary.json checks). Source shows role=toolbar, aria-pressed snap toggle, aria-live status, aria-modal dialog (index.html:11,26,49,52) and focus-visible outlines (styles.css:53-56). But canvas items are plain divs — Tab is intercepted for selection cycling (app.js:503-507) so objects are outside DOM focus order, and low-contrast/11px text tokens (--ink-3 #9b988a styles.css:12; kbd 11px styles.css:49) are consistent with the contrast fail.

frontend_rework.evidence: No visible layout defects at 1280x860 or 1440x900; layout.responsive_collision and text.truncation pass. However the receipt records layout.overflow fail and type.min_projected_size fail (measurement-summary.json checks) — implying rework on overflow and on 11px text (kbd styles.css:49, zone-tag small styles.css:163, purpose-chip styles.css:226-229); the 绿植 chip visibly truncates to '动手…' in both screenshots.

acceptance_seed_coverage.evidence: Seed 'spatial operations have keyboard equivalents' is exhaustively addressed: a dedicated 键盘等价物速查 overlay declares '每个空间操作都有键盘等价物' (source/index.html:52-104) and the keydown contract implements them — Tab/Shift+Tab cycle, arrows/Shift+arrows/Alt+arrows nudge+smart-align, 1-6 align, d/D distribute, [/] z-order, g snap toggle, N create, Ctrl+D duplicate, Del delete, Enter rename, Ctrl+Z/Y undo/redo, Ctrl+A select-all (app.js:492-553); hints repeated in the status bar (app.js:204).

scores.overall_note: impl-08 is a single-screen floor-plan board ('落位台 SetPlot') whose representation matches the brief's create × spatial-workspace cell almost point-for-point: purpose zones, draggable canvas_object cards, and a placement-is-intent rule where an item's purpose chip is derived from its zone (app.js:87-92, 150-154). The primary create/place task is salient and reachable in one action, all spatial operations have documented and implemented keyboard equivalents (the brief's acceptance seed), and context is preserved via in-place editing and undo/redo. The measurable weaknesses are in the receipt, not the visible layout: a11y.contrast and type.min_projected_size fail and layout.overflow fails without a visible correlate in either screenshot, while a11y.focus_order was skipped, leaving keyboard-focus accessibility unverified beyond source reading; canvas items also sit outside the DOM focus order by design. Error rate is reported objectively as 3 pass / 3 fail / 1 skipped with a valid target. Model judgment only — no human preference, task time, or retrieval accuracy is observable in this blind pilot.
